programme_name_exact: MSc in Data Science and Business Analytics
degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale / Master of Science, 120 CFU
english_req: English certificate not required for selection but must be provided by the enrolment deadline and in any case by end of June 2027
other_tests: GMAT or GRE score, or the online Bocconi admission test
quantitative_prereqs: No published minimum CFU per disciplinary sector; programme states it is designed for applicants with a strong computational, statistical and mathematical background
fit_notes: 180-ECTS licence satisfies the first-cycle requirement and the quantitative profile (Python, scikit-learn, SQL) matches the stated computational orientation. Fee is a single flat amount not linked to ISEE and identical for EU and non-EU applicants; the 2027-28 fee was not yet published.

programme_name_exact: Master's Degree Programme in Data Science and Management
degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale, degree class LM-91, 120 CFU
faculty_or_school: Luiss Department of Business and Management
english_req: B2 English, assessed during the admission test
quantitative_prereqs: Direct curricular access for Italian first-cycle classes L-8/L-31/L-33/L-35/L-41; otherwise at least 48 CFU across the listed areas, of which at least 24 CFU in ECON-01/A, ECON-06/A, ECON-07/A, ECON-08/A, STAT-01/A, INFO-01/A, IINF-01/A (a.y. 2027/2028 requirements)
fit_notes: A Business Intelligence licence is likely to satisfy the 24-CFU quantitative/IT core but this must be checked credit by credit against the published SSD list. Admission notices and the full calendar for a.y. 2027/2028 are published only from November 2026.

degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale in Data Analytics for Business, degree class LM-82 R, 120 CFU
faculty_or_school: Faculty of Economics and Faculty of Mathematical, Physical and Natural Sciences
other_tests: Evaluation test of English language proficiency
fit_notes: Fee shown is the fixed 2026/27 amount for students whose family income is produced outside the EU, reducible to about 6400 EUR with the UCSC International Scholarship. programme_name_exact: Data Analytics for Business and Society
faculty_or_school: Department of Economics / Department of Environmental Sciences, Informatics and Statistics
quantitative_prereqs: Minimum 60 CFU across the listed academic fields, including at least 12 CFU in Economics and Business fields and at least 12 CFU in the Statistical-Mathematical field
fit_notes: Non-EU flat fee of 1300 EUR replaces the ISEE calculation entirely, so no ISEE-parificato is needed; Tunisia falls in the general non-EU bracket, not the Low Human Development bracket. The recorded date is the Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for a.y. 2026/27, which precedes the university's own pre-evaluation deadline.

institution: Alma Mater Studiorum - Universita di Bologna
programme_name_exact: Statistics, Economics and Business - curriculum Business Analytics
degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale (second cycle degree / two year master), 120 CFU
faculty_or_school: Department of Statistical Sciences Paolo Fortunati
english_req: B2 English (OOPT test at the Bologna University Language Centre, or a first/second cycle degree taught in English, or a B2 English exam in a previous degree)
other_tests: Remote interview via MS Teams; adequacy threshold 60/100
quantitative_prereqs: At least 22 CFU in total: minimum 16 CFU in probability and statistics (SECS-S/01, 02, 03, 05; MAT/06) or mathematics (SECS-S/06; MAT/02, 03, 05, 07, 08, 09), of which at least 8 CFU in probability and statistics; plus at least 6 CFU in economics (SECS-P/01, 02, 03, 05, 06) or business economics and management (SECS-P/07, 08, 09)
fit_notes: Fee recorded is the reduced fixed contribution for non-EU non-OECD citizens with income and assets only outside Italy (1200 EUR plus the 157.04 EUR fixed fee), which requires checking Tunisia against the published non-OECD list. The 22-CFU curricular threshold is the binding filter for a Business Intelligence licence.

degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale (equivalent to Master of Science), 120 CFU
faculty_or_school: School of Industrial and Information Engineering
english_req: Certified English proficiency mandatory for admission: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 78, Cambridge B2 First or C1 Advanced, PTE Academic 59, Trinity ISE II, LanguageCert ESOL B2, TOEIC 720
quantitative_prereqs: Valid first-cycle degree with adequate academic background assessed by the Evaluation Committee; no published minimum CFU per disciplinary sector for foreign qualifications
fit_notes: Non-EU students with a foreign first-level qualification and no ISEE are charged the maximum amount, so the figure recorded is the effective non-EU fee. Italian language is an OFA graduation obligation, not an admission requirement.

programme_name_exact: Data Science for Economics and Health
degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale, degree class LM-DATA, 120 CFU
faculty_or_school: Department of Computer Science Giovanni degli Antoni and Department of Economics, Management and Quantitative Methods
other_tests: Written online admission test in English; interview may be required
quantitative_prereqs: At least 30 ECTS in computer science and mathematics (MAT-01 to MAT-09, INF-01, ING-INF/05), or in economic sciences and statistics (SECS-S/01, 02, 03, 06; SECS-P/01, 02, 03, 05, 07, 08, 10), or in medical sciences (MED/01)
fit_notes: Fee recorded is the fixed second instalment for Group C (household income produced abroad) plus the 190 EUR first instalment, so it does not depend on ISEE. The 30-ECTS quantitative threshold is plausibly met by a Business Intelligence licence but must be verified per exam.

programme_name_exact: Master of Science in Data Science
faculty_or_school: Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science
other_tests: Selection on academic curriculum and merit; application fee 30 EUR
quantitative_prereqs: 6 ECTS in computer science or computer engineering, 6 ECTS in social sciences, economics, psychology or law, 6 ECTS in mathematics or statistics, plus 24 further ECTS in these or related disciplines; missing credits may be completed before enrolment
fit_notes: Figure recorded is the highest first-year band for Group A programmes for non-EU citizens; the fee falls to zero for applicants scoring 90/100 or more at admission, and 81 places are reserved for non-EU nationals living abroad. Business and economics is one of the programme's declared domain specialisations, which is what places it in Track A.

degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale (equivalent to Master of Science), 120 CFU
english_req: English language certificate at minimum B2 level (CEFR)
other_tests: Merit ranking out of 100 points: 50 portfolio, 20 CV, 30 GPA

fit_notes: Entry is conditional: a Business Intelligence licence would have to be accepted under the information technologies heading, and the portfolio carries half the ranking score. The applicant's videography and editing practice is the relevant portfolio material.

degree_awarded: Laurea Magistrale (equivalent to Master of Science), 120 CFU
